name: friendliai
description: OpenAI-compatible inference on FriendliAI Model APIs and Dedicated Endpoints
long_description: Bring a FriendliAI Personal API key (`flp_...`); the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists at most one of your Dedicated Endpoints (GET /dedicated/beta/endpoint), which runs no inference and costs nothing. A Sprite can then run chat completions, Responses, Anthropic-style Messages, text completions and tokenization on serverless Model APIs (charged per token), the same calls plus embeddings, image generation and text classification on your own Dedicated Endpoints, list serverless models, and read the specification and status of your Dedicated Endpoints. Requests use your default team. Creating, updating, sleeping, waking, restarting, terminating or deleting endpoints, datasets, files, team usage and cost, API keys and account settings are not forwarded.

presentation.tagline: FriendliAI serverless and dedicated inference from a Sprite without putting your key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in to Friendli Suite, open Settings → API Keys (friendli.ai/suite/~/setting/keys) and click Create API Key. Copy the key (it starts with `flp_`) when it is shown; you cannot see it again.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key calls `GET /dedicated/beta/endpoint?limit=1`, which runs no inference and costs nothing. Serverless Model APIs calls are charged per input and output token at the model's price (`GET /serverless/v1/models` lists them); FriendliAI does not say whether tokenize and detokenize are charged. The endpoint reads run no inference. Dedicated Endpoints are billed per GPU-second for every running replica, whether or not it serves requests, and a request to a sleeping endpoint wakes it. The key check does not verify your credit balance.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Forwarded: `GET /serverless/v1/models`; `POST` `/serverless/v1/` `chat/completions`, `responses`, `messages`, `completions`, `tokenize` and `detokenize`; `POST` `/dedicated/v1/` `chat/completions`, `responses`, `messages`, `completions`, `embeddings`, `tokenize`, `detokenize` and `images/generations`, plus `POST /dedicated/classify`; `GET /dedicated/beta/endpoint`, `GET /dedicated/beta/endpoint/:endpoint_id` and `GET /dedicated/beta/endpoint/:endpoint_id/status`. Not forwarded: endpoint create, update, delete, sleep, wake, restart and terminate, tool-assisted chat, audio transcription, image edits, chat render, knowledge retrieval, datasets, files, team usage and cost, and API keys. The `X-Friendli-Team` header is not forwarded, so requests use your default team.

usage_notes: Sprites waits 120 seconds for response headers and FriendliAI has no request timeout parameter, so set `stream: true` (Server-Sent Events) or a modest `max_tokens` for long generations, especially with reasoning models.
Error bodies are `{"detail": "..."}`, sometimes with a `_status` field; a bad key answers 401.
